title: Delhi HC Grants Summary Judgment Permanently Barring Jabalpur Developer From 'ANANTARA' Mark
case_name: MHG IP Holding (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. & Ors. v. Evergreen Dealcom Pvt. Ltd. & Ors.
card_summary: The plaintiffs have used the ANANTARA mark for hotels and resorts since 2000. The defendants ran residential projects at Jabalpur, marketed as 'ANANTARA DOWNTOWN' and 'ANANTARA RESIDENCE' on 99acres and Facebook, and neither appeared nor filed a written statement. Justice Kaurav granted summary judgment, restrained the defendants for good, and ordered the material destroyed and their registration cancelled.
card_tip: A defendant who skips appearance and never files a written statement in a trademark suit leaves the door open to summary judgment, permanent injunction and cancellation of its own registration in one order.
verification_notes: The case number (CS(COMM) 267/2026), the plaintiffs' 2000/2001 first use, the Jabalpur location and the two impugned names, the defendants' non-appearance, and the 15 October 2026 summary judgment with injunction and registration cancellation are consistent across LiveLawBiz and Advocate Gandhi's report.
